observations: photo 0: one wooden pallet on a concrete floor; visible stringers and deck boards; some discoloration/staining on boards; red-painted underside edge is visible.
photo 1: another view of a wooden pallet; similar construction; visible gaps/openings; staining and wear on top boards.
photo 2: stack of multiple wooden pallets in a warehouse; pallets appear mixed in condition (some look darker/worn); no clear marking of pallet standard (e.g., ISPM/HT) visible.

claims.evidence: Photos show wooden pallets used for storage/handling (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: Photos show pallets with visible wear/staining; dryness/cleanliness and whether they are fully sorted cannot be confirmed remotely (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).
No test or moisture reading shown; cannot confirm from photos (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale ticket/receipt or photo of the certified weighing process shown (photo 0, photo 1, photo 2).

risks.risk: Moisture/treated-wood status (could be wet, or not heat-treated/ISPM-compliant), affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of any stamp/mark on the pallet (e.g., HT/DB/IPPC) plus a moisture meter reading (or a video showing the meter on the wood).
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed-condition pallets with unknown treatment/moisture (worst case: lower grade for reuse).

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch vs stated weight (500 kg) due to pallet count/size differences or inclusion of damaged pallets.
risks.proof: Request a photo/video of the certified scale reading with the pallets on it, and/or pallet count with dimensions of the pallet type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to be exactly 500 kg (worst case: assume fewer usable pallets).

risks.risk: Damage level (broken boards, weak stringers, missing nails) reducing load-bearing capacity.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the worst pallet(s): underside stringers and corners, plus a quick video of a pallet being lifted/checked.
risks.if_unproven: Price as some pallets may be damaged/less usable (worst case: treat as lower-grade for storage only).

risks.risk: Contamination (oil/chemicals) or infestation risk not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Request a smell/visual inspection video and close-ups of board surfaces and any dark spots; ask if they were used for food/chemicals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown contamination risk (worst case: discount for potential cleaning/limited use).

proof_requests: Photo/video of the certified weighing process showing the pallets on the scale and the reading (for the stated 500 kg).
Close-up photos of pallet stamps/marks on multiple pallets (look for HT/DB/IPPC or similar).
Moisture meter reading on at least 2–3 pallets (top deck and underside).
Close-ups of the most damaged pallets: corners and underside stringers.
response.reason: The item type (wooden pallets) is clear from the photos, but the key pricing drivers—exact quantity/weight, dryness, and treatment/compliance—are not verifiable remotely. Get the weighing proof and treatment/moisture evidence before pricing.
